title: Positing
description: Value enters predication by evidence: potential-transfinite-predication-cell --positing--> potential-scott-continuous-posit-cell (predicating/positing/fiber.mts). A posit is a predication cell bound to its charge — RelMath's Meme, the minimal transmissible unit of meaning-with-evidence (`memeSchema`, kind `predication.fiber.meme`). Charges are never admitted directly; they are constructed from evidence and joined. Scott-continuous structural regime, causal dynamical regime.
